verdict.rationale: Ollama is an LLM inference runtime and server, so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair performance axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents separating the prefill and decode phases or any disaggregated serving architecture. Running multiple models concurrently and dedicated cloud capacity are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
